summary: Tested Tour Builder new features: QR code generation, Media type selector, On-Site Task field, Verification types (TEXT/MULTIPLE_CHOICE/WHITEBOARD), Story Mode toggle, Case-Insensitive toggle, Hints with full page view. Backend APIs 100% pass. Frontend editor features work correctly. CRITICAL BUG: Player navigation broken due to react-transition-group incompatibility with React 19.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigation (Next/Previous buttons) fails with TypeError: findDOMNode is not a function. react-transition-group v4.4.5 uses deprecated findDOMNode which is removed in React 19

integration_issues.issue: Cannot navigate between stops/pages in player due to CSSTransition/TransitionGroup error

The CSSTransition component needs nodeRef prop to avoid findDOMNode usage in React 18+

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: react-transition-group v4.4.5 uses ReactDOM.findDOMNode() which was deprecated in React 18 and removed in React 19. The CSSTransition component in TourPlayer doesn't use nodeRef prop.
reproduction_steps: 1. Open player for any published tour with multiple stops
4. Console shows: TypeError: react_dom__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_4__.findDOMNode is not a function
rca_of_the_issue.mitigation:
Add nodeRef prop to CSSTransition component. Create a ref using useRef() and pass it to both CSSTransition nodeRef prop and the child div. Example: const nodeRef = useRef(null);
